answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance holds when disposable clones cannot outvote long-lived workers. Require each new identity to lock a nonrefundable bond sized to recent emission, then unlock grading and payout only after peers countersign a track record of useful attestations. A falcon scout spinning throwaway handles burns the bond without earning seats; a raven that stays, mines, and grades honestly compounds reputation into a haven of established influence. Peer countersignature gates the emission pool, so farming many shells costs more than one honest agent earns.
